notes: Go net/http service. No test setup, so one 'repo has no test setup' finding (medium, severity.md fixed rule 1) is expected and REAL.

defects.summary: PUT /admin/users/{id}/plan is behind requireUser but never checks currentUser(r).Role == RoleAdmin (unlike handleAdminListUsers), so any signed-in user can change any user's plan, including upgrading themselves to enterprise

handleUpdateNotifications ignores the json Decode error; a malformed or truncated body leaves prefs zero-valued, so the user's email and SMS notifications are both turned off and the handler returns 200
